受理/领取/消费三时点在同一处记账后再回灌：逻辑消费的唯一记账点。
manager 交给宿主的投递口：登记路由、受理通知并提交终态交付事实，不代签消费。

owners.reason: 通知身份与 outbox 提交由 task 层生产；通知经注入的 mailbox 端口交出，生产者不自行领取、消费或投递。
邮箱只实现受理/领取/消费/重领四个时点；它不铸造通知身份、不读自己的投影、不驱动回合。
执行器只读通知投影；它不经邮箱做第二份消费记账，也不代 task 层提交状态迁移。
随动消费者在同一处完成受理/领取/消费并回灌；它不铸造身份、不重领、不替宿主投递。
宿主只登记路由、受理通知并提交终态交付事实；领取与消费属于随动消费者，宿主不复制第二份消费状态。
组合根的提交面只把 task.Manager 注入的状态迁移转交 MemoryRegistry.Advance；它不另写通知身份，也不碰邮箱。

LoadScan.concept: read cost measurement of one prefix scanned while the carrier rebuilds from the durable record kinds

LoadStats.concept: read cost measurement set of the carrier rebuild

GenerationConfig.concept: model generation parameters one request carries (原生采样字段随请求进同一执行代)

GenHostSpec.concept: host document dialect one candidate generation is published under (contract: docs/adr/0007-generation-scoped-runtime-plugin-lifecycle.md)

GenerationConsumer.concept: generation-scoped consumer registration as the run reports it

GenerationFaces.concept: per-generation native face of every declared agent

GenRegistry.concept: generation-scoped consumer registry of one assembly

GenBuilder.concept: construction of one registered consumer's per-generation instance

GenBuilt.concept: one constructed consumer of one candidate generation

GenInstances.concept: constructed consumer set of one candidate generation

GenRegistration.concept: one consumer's mount on the generation-scoped registry

GenResources.concept: what one per-generation consumer construction answers (独占资源账 + 复原面)

Plan.concept: one reflection section a document enables, resolved at its mount

Faces.concept: run faces one mounted reflection is assembled over

SFTInput.concept: one input a batched turn presented, beside the source it came from

RequestEvidenceRecord.concept: durable request evidence of one model decision

AtomicStore.concept: the atomic storage engine every tier opens: one commit behind one barrier and one read face

Batch.concept: one write set committed as a unit

Fetch.concept: one read: a named key, or every key under a named prefix

Pair.concept: one key-value entry a read returns or a commit writes

ChainFailureNamer.concept: durable read face naming why it answers no readable event for one key

EvidenceExporter.concept: assembly of training rows from the request evidence one capture landed

EvidenceLines.concept: read-only face of the record lines one capture landed

FileEvidenceLines.concept: record lines one capture directory holds

SnapshotReadBack.concept: read-back of the runtime request snapshot one reference names

EvidenceOptions.concept: bounds of the rows one evidence export emits

SFTDataset.concept: SFT export of one evidence chain: assembled rows beside refused rows

SFTRow.concept: one supervised fine-tuning row assembled from landed evidence

PreferenceDataset.concept: preference export of one evidence chain: assembled pairs beside refused rows

PreferenceRow.concept: one preference pair assembled from landed evidence

DatasetRefusal.concept: one row an export refused, named so an operator routes it

RefusalName.concept: name of the way one export row was refused

Checkpoint.concept: framework checkpoint fact: one cut carrying every recoverable state slice the consumers delegated to the framework

CheckpointOffset.concept: partition-sequence watermark one checkpoint covers: the committed sequence slot of every partition at the cut

CheckpointSlice.concept: one state slice a checkpoint carries: the consumer name it is keyed by beside that consumer's own payload

CheckpointPayload.concept: payload layout of one checkpoint fact: the layout version, the identity it content-addresses to, the cut and the state slices

Stateful.concept: one consumer's recoverable state as the framework sees it: the name it is keyed by, the state it states and the restore that puts it back

StateRegistry.concept: ordered account of the state holders mounted on one runtime, aggregated at one cut and restored from one

RegistryCheckpoint.concept: task account a checkpoint states: one entry per task record the registry holds at the cut

TaskCheckpoint.concept: one task record as a checkpoint states it: the admission declaration, the held state and the chain revision that state corresponds to
